title: Renewal funnel mosaic ops sheet - Apr 2027
content:
Sheet: Renewal Funnel Mosaic (working)

Columns:
Account | ARR USD | Contract Start | Contract End | Days to Renewal | Renewal Stage | Probability % | Weighted ARR | Renewal Owner | Next Action (1-2 sentences) | Last Contact | Playbook / Template | Risk Notes

Header notes:
- Probabilities are suggested by stage (Renewal Stage mapping below) but owners should override with rationale.
- Weighted ARR = ARR * Probability% (used for coverage math)
- Days to Renewal = DAYS(Contract End, TODAY()) — use as a red/yellow/green signal

Stage -> default probability guidance (for quick scoring):
- Stabilized (no exec touch, satisfied): 90
- Partnering (regular QBRs, expansion motion): 80
- At-risk (support incidents, exec churn): 40
- Negotiating (legal/pricing in flight): 70
- Late (<30d, no PO): 30
- Expired (lapsed but still using): 10

Data rows (sample working data):
Acme Retail | 1,200,000 | 2024-05-01 | 2027-05-30 | 48 | Negotiating | 70 | 840,000 | Jordan Alvarez | "Confirm final SOW draft; secure executive sponsor call next week" | 2027-04-11 | Renewal-negotiation-template-v3 | "Legal pushed new SLA language; finance awaiting revised PO; chase PM"
FinData Labs | 420,000 | 2025-03-15 | 2027-06-15 | 64 | Partnering | 80 | 336,000 | Maya Chen | "Prepare expansion case study + updated usage analysis; schedule QBR" | 2027-04-14 | Expansion-playbook | "Usage growing 18% q/q; no current churn signals"
Nimble Health | 250,000 | 2023-07-01 | 2027-05-05 | 23 | At-risk | 40 | 100,000 | Priya Menon | "Urgent: ops team to remediate latency incidents; offer 30-day credit and joint RCA" | 2027-04-17 | Customer-incident-escalation | "Recent P3 incidents; exec unhappy; legal looped in for indemnity clause"
MetroAI | 95,000 | 2026-04-01 | 2027-04-28 | 15 | Late | 30 | 28,500 | Liam O'Connor | "Confirm renewed PO or enable auto-renew option; propose 10% prepay discount" | 2027-04-12 | Fast-close-template | "Procurement cycle stretched; finance on vacation until 4/25"
Atlas Systems | 2,400,000 | 2024-06-01 | 2027-10-10 | 180 | Stabilized | 90 | 2,160,000 | Anika Rao | "Standard renewal; present three-tier option for consolidation; low risk" | 2027-03-30 | Consolidation-playbook | "Multi-year strategic customer; sales pursuing cross-sell"
SmallCo | 18,000 | 2026-05-10 | 2027-05-02 | 20 | Expired | 10 | 1,800 | Priya Menon | "Invoice outstanding; product limited feature usage; offer light retention discount" | 2027-04-09 | Small-account-template | "Usage dropped off; AE flagged as low priority"

Summary section (auto-calc guidance):
- Total ARR in view (sample rows): 4,383,000
- Total Weighted ARR (sample): 3,466,300
- Coverage ratio = Weighted ARR / ARR target (example target = 3,000,000) => 115% (healthy)
- Top 3 at-risk accounts by risk score (manual): Nimble Health, MetroAI, SmallCo

Operational TODOs / Notes (working):
- Action owners must update Probability % and Next Action field after each touch. 
- Add column for "Legal status" (draft / redlines / final) next iteration.
- Integrate with CS CRM webhook: pending CS-621 (see linked_artifacts) — aim to automate Days to Renewal and Last Contact.
- QBR playbook: prepare 1-pager on cost vs performance benefits for accounts >$500k ARR.

Quick color legend (sheet conditional formatting guide):
- Days to Renewal <=30 -> Red
- Days to Renewal 31-90 -> Yellow
- Days to Renewal >90 -> Green
- Probability <=40% -> Red highlight

Unresolved questions / Discussion points (for weekly sync):
- Should we weight 'Partnering' at 85% for ARR >$1M? (pros/cons on conservatism)
- How to capture cross-sell pipeline inside same row vs separate motions? (affects weighted ARR)
- Should we include an "Escalation level" column (CRO / VP / Director) for exec-involved renewals?

Revision log (short):
- 2027-04-12: initial draft imported from regional trackers (Priya)
- 2027-04-14: added MetroAI + Nimble Health rows after ops sync (Maya)
- 2027-04-18: updated probability guidance and added legal reminder (Jordan)

End of sheet (working).
